ideas.pitch: An automated digital forensics tool designed to rapidly extract hidden payloads from steganographic images and audio files during CTF challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Digital forensics, reverse engineering, OSINT, steganography, and other cybersecurity-related challenges.
ideas.title: SteganoSleuth AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a high-friction category in CTFs (steganography and digital forensics) by automating multi-layered LSB extraction and metadata analysis, directly saving valuable competition time.

ideas.pitch: A modular cryptographic puzzle solver specifically tailored for classic and modern CTF ciphers, including automated frequency analysis and RSA weak-key attacks.
ideas.problem_statement: Cryptography, reverse engineering, OSINT, steganography, and other cybersecurity-related challenges.
ideas.title: CryptoBreaker Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an unfair speed advantage in cryptography challenges by instantly performing lattice reductions and factorization attacks on common CTF puzzle configurations.

ideas.pitch: A specialized web exploitation reconnaissance dashboard that automatically fingerprints vulnerable endpoints, SQLi parameters, and SSRF entry points for CTF web challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Web exploitation, cryptography, digital forensics, reverse engineering, OSINT, steganography, and other cybersecurity-related challenges.
ideas.title: WebVuln Recon Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Web exploitation challenges require fast enumeration; this tool automates payload fuzzing and parameter discovery cleanly within a unified interface.

ideas.pitch: An automated intelligence-gathering and link-analysis tool for OSINT challenges that aggregates social footprints, metadata leaks, and geolocation clues into a visual graph.
ideas.problem_statement: OSINT, steganography, and other cybersecurity-related challenges.
ideas.title: OSINT Grapher
ideas.why_it_could_win: OSINT challenges are notorious for unstructured data chaos; a visual connection grapher immediately highlights hidden entity relationships and flags.

ideas.pitch: A rapid static analysis helper for reverse engineering CTF challenges that parses binary headers, extracts strings, and flags suspicious packed sections or hardcoded keys.
ideas.problem_statement: Reverse engineering, steganography, and other cybersecurity-related challenges.
ideas.title: BinaryInspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Cuts down initial reverse engineering setup time by instantly displaying decompiled hints, architecture details, and embedded flags in a single dashboard.
